title: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
description: 80 questions about the story and characters of The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, from season 1 to season 5. Each game asks you 10.

questions.text: What is Midge's real first name?
questions.explanation: Everyone calls her Midge, but her full name is Miriam Maisel.

questions.text: In which year does the story begin?
questions.explanation: The first episode is set in New York City in 1958.

questions.text: Where does Midge live at the start of the story?
questions.explanation: Her parents live upstairs in the same building.

options.text: On the Upper West Side of Manhattan

questions.text: What was Midge's last name before she married Joel?
questions.explanation: She is the daughter of Abe and Rose Weissman.

questions.text: What are the names of Midge and Joel's two children?
questions.explanation: Ethan and Esther are Midge and Joel's children.

questions.text: What does Midge's father, Abe, do for a living at the start?
questions.explanation: Abe is a math professor at Columbia University.

options.text: He teaches math at Columbia University
He is a doctor at a hospital
He is a lawyer in Manhattan

questions.text: What is Joel's day job in season 1?
questions.explanation: Joel works at Tri-Borough Plastics during the day.

options.text: He works at a plastics company
He works at an insurance company
He works in a department store

questions.text: What does Joel secretly dream of becoming?
questions.explanation: Joel tries stand-up comedy at night, with little success.

questions.text: Whose jokes does Joel steal for his act?
questions.explanation: Midge finds out that Joel has been copying Bob Newhart.

questions.text: In which comedy club does Midge perform for the first time?
questions.explanation: The Gaslight Cafe is where Joel performs and where Midge first grabs the microphone.

questions.text: Who is Joel's mistress when he leaves Midge?
questions.explanation: Joel leaves Midge for his secretary, Penny Pann.

questions.text: What is Midge drinking before she takes the stage for the first time?
questions.explanation: Midge has been drinking wine when she heads to the Gaslight.

questions.text: What is Midge wearing when she goes on stage for the first time?
questions.explanation: She walks into the club and performs in her nightgown.

questions.text: How does Midge's first night on stage end?
questions.explanation: Her bold, unplanned set ends with the police taking her away.

options.text: Joel takes the microphone from her

questions.text: Who bails Midge out after her first night and offers to manage her?
questions.explanation: Susie, who works at the Gaslight, sees Midge's talent right away.

questions.text: Which famous comic is arrested the same night as Midge?
questions.explanation: Midge meets Lenny Bruce that night, and he becomes an important friend.

questions.text: Where does Midge work in season 1?
questions.explanation: She sells cosmetics at the B. Altman department store.

options.text: At the makeup counter of a department store

questions.text: Who owns the apartment where Midge and Joel live?
questions.explanation: Moishe reveals that he owns it and plans to sell it.

questions.text: Where does Midge go to live after she splits up with Joel?
questions.explanation: She moves back in with Abe and Rose.

questions.text: At which outdoor place does Midge perform at a protest in season 1?
questions.explanation: Midge takes her act to a protest in Washington Square Park.

questions.text: What gets Midge blacklisted from most clubs at the end of season 1?
questions.explanation: Midge goes after Sophie's act in public, and the powerful people around Sophie make sure the clubs shut Midge out.

options.text: She mocks the star Sophie Lennon on stage
She shows up late for a big show
She refuses to pay a club owner
She tells jokes about Lenny Bruce

questions.text: What is Sophie Lennon's stage character?
questions.explanation: Sophie plays a working-class woman from Queens, and the character is not who she really is.

questions.text: Who is the manager of the comic Sophie Lennon in season 1?
questions.explanation: Harry Drake manages Sophie, and he has a lot of power over the clubs.

questions.text: What does Midge announce at the end of her set in the season 1 finale?
questions.explanation: She finishes by introducing herself as Mrs. Maisel.

options.text: That her name is Mrs. Maisel
That she is moving to Paris

questions.text: Who are Joel's parents?
questions.explanation: Moishe and Shirley Maisel are Joel's parents.

questions.text: What business does Joel's family run?
questions.explanation: Moishe's family business makes clothes.

questions.text: What secret job does Midge's brother Noah turn out to have?
questions.explanation: Noah's secret job as a government agent surprises the whole family.

questions.text: Why do Abe and Midge fly to Paris in season 2?
questions.explanation: Rose has moved to Paris, and Abe and Midge go to bring her back.

questions.text: What does Rose study after she returns from Paris?
questions.explanation: Rose sits in on art classes at Columbia, where Abe teaches.

questions.text: Where do Midge's and Joel's families spend the summer in season 2?
questions.explanation: Both families spend the summer in the Catskill Mountains.

options.text: At a resort in the Catskills
At a beach house in the Hamptons
On a farm on Cape Cod
At a hotel near Niagara Falls

questions.text: What big secret about Midge does Abe learn on that summer vacation?
questions.explanation: Abe finds out about Midge's act at the resort, and he is upset by it.

options.text: That she is moving to Paris
That she is learning to fly

questions.text: What new business does Rose start in seasons 3 and 4?
questions.explanation: Rose discovers that she has a real talent for matchmaking.

questions.text: How do mysterious rivals warn Rose to stop her new business?
questions.explanation: A secret group of local matchmakers sends her perfumed letters.

options.text: With notes left on her doorstep

questions.text: For which newspaper does Abe become a theater critic?
questions.explanation: Abe becomes a theater critic at The Village Voice in season 3.

questions.text: Which famous research lab gives Abe a job?
questions.explanation: Abe starts working at Bell Labs in season 1.

questions.text: After their money troubles, with whom do Abe and Rose go to live?
questions.explanation: In season 3 the Weissmans move in with the Maisels.

questions.text: What does Rose give up after a falling-out with her wealthy family?
questions.explanation: Rose turns her back on the family money.

questions.text: Alfie hypnotizes Rose on stage. What does she do?
questions.explanation: It shows that Rose has secretly watched Midge perform.

options.text: She performs part of Midge's stand-up act

questions.text: In season 2, Midge moves to which job at the department store?
questions.explanation: She leaves the makeup counter and works on the switchboard.

questions.text: Who invites Midge to open for his tour at the end of season 2?
questions.explanation: Midge says yes to a long tour of the US and Europe.

questions.text: At the end of season 2, who does Midge turn to for comfort?
questions.explanation: Even though they are separated, Midge goes to Joel.

questions.text: What is the first stop on Midge's tour with Shy?
questions.explanation: It is the biggest crowd Midge has ever performed for.

questions.text: In which city does Joel visit Midge during the tour?
questions.explanation: Joel turns up at her show in Las Vegas.

questions.text: What surprising thing happens after Joel visits Midge in Las Vegas?
questions.explanation: After a drunken night out, they discover they are married again, and they agree to cancel it.

questions.text: Who stops Midge and Susie from boarding the plane to Europe?
questions.explanation: Reggie ends the tour after Midge's jokes at the Apollo.

questions.text: At which theater does Midge's set cost her the tour?
questions.explanation: Her jokes about Shy at the Apollo get her thrown off the tour.

questions.text: How does season 3 end for Midge and Susie?
questions.explanation: They watch Shy's plane leave without them.

options.text: They are stranded on the airport tarmac

questions.text: What bad habit puts Susie in trouble on the tour?
questions.explanation: Susie starts gambling in Las Vegas, and it gets out of control.

questions.text: Who ends up managing Midge's money after Susie loses it?
questions.explanation: Susie asks Joel to look after the money, since she does not trust herself.

questions.text: Which rival comic does Susie sign as a client in season 3?
questions.explanation: Susie takes on Sophie to make ends meet, which upsets Midge.

questions.text: What does Sophie do on opening night of her serious play?
questions.explanation: Sophie goes back to her Queens character, and the critics are not kind.

options.text: She freezes and falls back on her old act

questions.text: What does Joel find in the basement of the building for his club?
questions.explanation: The cheap rent comes with a surprise below the club.

questions.text: What does Mei Lin help Joel get for his club?
questions.explanation: Mei helps Joel get the license he needs to serve drinks.

questions.text: What goes wrong on the opening night of Joel's club?
questions.explanation: Midge goes on stage and entertains the crowd until the lights come back.

questions.text: Who becomes Joel's new girlfriend in season 3?
questions.explanation: Joel meets Mei Lin while planning his club.

questions.text: Why does Abe quitting his jobs alarm Rose at the end of season 2?
questions.explanation: If Abe leaves the university, the Weissmans could lose their home.

options.text: The university owns the family's apartment
He wants to move to Paris
He wants to become a comedian

questions.text: What job does Benjamin, Midge's boyfriend in season 2, have?
questions.explanation: Dr. Benjamin Ettenberg is a Manhattan doctor whom Midge meets on vacation.

questions.text: What new rule does Midge set for herself in season 4?
questions.explanation: Midge decides she will only headline her own shows.

options.text: She will no longer open for other acts
She will never perform on weekends
She will only tell new jokes
She will stop talking about Joel

questions.text: Where does Midge perform in season 4?
questions.explanation: At the Wolford she can say whatever she likes.

questions.text: What happens at the Wolford at the end of season 4?
questions.explanation: The raid ends the night, and Midge and Lenny run off together.

questions.text: Whose opening slot does Midge turn down in season 4?
questions.explanation: Lenny arranges the offer, but Midge refuses because of her new rule.

questions.text: Where is Lenny Bruce booked to perform in the season 4 finale?
questions.explanation: The finale is named after the old joke about how to get to Carnegie Hall.

questions.text: What news makes Moishe have a heart attack in season 4?
questions.explanation: Moishe is shocked when Joel tells him about the baby.

options.text: Joel and Mei are expecting a baby

questions.text: What does Susie's client Alfie do?
questions.explanation: Susie signs Alfie, a magician, as a new client.

questions.text: What does Midge see in the last scene of season 4?
questions.explanation: It points her toward her next big move.

options.text: An advertisement for The Gordon Ford Show

questions.text: What is Mike Carr's job?
questions.explanation: Susie knows Mike from the show, which could help Midge.

options.text: He books guests for The Gordon Ford Show
He hosts The Gordon Ford Show
He writes jokes for the host

questions.text: What job does Midge get on The Gordon Ford Show?
questions.explanation: Susie pushes Midge into a job as a writer on the late-night show.

questions.text: What rule on The Gordon Ford Show frustrates Midge?
questions.explanation: Midge wants to be a comic, but the show keeps its writers off camera.

options.text: Writers are not allowed to perform on air

questions.text: In the series finale, how much airtime does Midge take over?
questions.explanation: Gordon cuts a segment short, and Midge fills the four minutes herself.

questions.text: How does Gordon Ford react after Midge's set?
questions.explanation: He is impressed, but she broke his rule about writers.

options.text: He fires her for breaking his rule
He makes her the new host

questions.text: Who does Susie ask for help to get Midge booked on the show?
questions.explanation: Susie uses her old connection to Hedy.

questions.text: What do we learn about Susie and Hedy in season 5?
questions.explanation: Susie and Hedy have a shared past, which helps Midge get her chance.

options.text: They were rivals at a comedy club

questions.text: What TV quiz show do Midge and Susie watch together in 2005?
questions.explanation: In the last scene they watch it from separate homes.

questions.text: At which famous New York club is Susie honored with a roast?
questions.explanation: Susie is honored at the Friars Club.

questions.text: In the flash-forwards, in which country does Midge visit her grown son Ethan?
questions.explanation: Midge travels to Israel to see Ethan in a flash-forward.

questions.text: What trouble does Joel get into in the 1980s flash-forward?
questions.explanation: Joel's arrest is one of the story's flash-forwards.

questions.text: In the 1965 flashback, what does Lenny do when Susie offers to help him?
questions.explanation: Lenny refuses Susie's help, even though he is struggling.

options.text: He hires her as his manager

questions.text: How does the friendship between Midge and Susie turn out?
questions.explanation: The flash-forwards show a long break between them, and a reconciliation.

options.text: They fall out for years, then make up
They stay close the whole time

questions.text: What does the future hold for Midge in the flash-forwards?
questions.explanation: Midge's career takes off, even if her personal life stays complicated.

options.text: She becomes a very famous comedian
She goes back to the makeup counter

questions.text: The series ends with a jump forward to which year?
questions.explanation: The final scene shows Midge and Susie in 2005.
